base: Use case: stylized-concept. Make a review draft for the game 8 bit Missoula. Strict coarse 8 bit pixel art aesthetic, as if drawn at 384 by 256 logical pixels and enlarged with nearest neighbor. Every edge uses the same visible square pixel grid. Flat color clusters, restrained palette of 24 colors, dark teal outlines, warm cream, pine green, brick red and muted amber. No gradients, no soft lighting, no glossy 3D, no painterly texture, no antialiasing, no tiny high resolution details. Keep recognizable shapes and clear floor space. Characters use matching pixel density and about 24 pixel tall bodies. Landscape 3:2. This is art direction for review, not a screenshot or a production atlas.

scenes.detail: Input image is a composition reference. Redraw the entire main town as coarse 8 bit pixel art. Preserve the Wilma on the left, university clock tower and M mountain behind, four storefronts, arcade on right with terrace, uphill A frame cabin, river paths and bridge, carousel foreground. Keep this layout recognizable. Include a bald bearded man in pale blue hoodie black shorts and red shoes talking to an elderly neighbor on a bench, two walkers, cyclist, angler by river, small black and white dog near cabin. Their feet and hands must contact ground or props clearly. Simplify shop signs into clean pixel labels rather than tiny imitation type. Match actor pixels to scenery pixels.

Bald bearded blue hoodie player at entry with small cyan robot companion beside him, not overlapping. No random stools through legs. No gradients or glossy rendering.

cabinEdit: Remove the entire foreground review card, stars, rating, title and review wording. Reconstruct the continuous wood floor, central walking space and entry. Preserve cabin composition, furniture, book reader, seated man, sleeping dog and pixel art treatment.
playerModel: Create a clean pixel art character model sheet for the game 8 bit Missoula. Only ONE character repeated: a bald light skinned adult man with a short brown beard, pale sky blue hoodie with a small white bison on front, black shorts with bare calves, bright red shoes. Preserve this exact identity and clothing in EVERY cell. Strict 8 bit game sprites, coarse square pixels, a fixed 24 by 32 logical pixel sprite in each cell. Flat palette of 8 colors per sprite, no gradients or soft edges or texture. Dark teal background. Four columns clearly labeled DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT, UP. Five rows clearly labeled IDLE, WALK, CARRY, REACH, SIT. Exactly 20 complete sprites in a regular grid with generous empty padding and consistent feet baseline. DOWN means front view, UP means full back view with NO face or beard visible, LEFT and RIGHT are true side silhouettes. CARRY row holds a small pizza box at waist height with hands under box, keeping arms attached in all four facings. REACH row has bent elbows and hands forward toward an implied control surface, not arms spread sideways. SIT row has bent hips and knees with thighs horizontal and lower legs hanging, not a squashed standing body. WALK row one clear stride pose per facing. No furniture, no scene, no diagrams, no ratings. These are rough sprite design proposals for a review, do not include those words in the image.
arcadeExtra: Be much more visibly low resolution than the reference. Characters must be the same pixel size as cabinet details, with simple 3 color clothing and block hands, no smoothly outlined cartoon people.
roofExtra: Only the scene itself. No labels, text panels, ratings, review cards, headings or UI overlays.
mainExtra: This is only the title illustration. No ratings, no review notes, no score panel. Keep all elements chunky and simple.
